integrity: Proof gives an explicit sufficient local criterion and exact CRT density; standalone standard-library verifier checks exact residue counts and arithmetic. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The rational constant is exactly the density of a constructive finite-prime certificate subset, not the full set of Zumkeller-plus-square sums. The density-zero exceptional-set conjecture remains open; no claim of a best-possible lower bound.
title: A 76.43 percent lower-density certificate for Zumkeller-plus-square sums
